self-targeted knockdown using CD 44 siRNA improves cisplatin resistance of chemoresistant NSCLS cells.

the development of a liposome-based siRNA delivery system for the treatment of chemoresistant NSCLS cells.

the relationship between chemoresistance and the expression of CD4 in NSCLC cells, and the development of an effective targeted delivery system for the self-targeted knockdown and overcoming of chemoresistance.
the development of a new strategy for the targeted therapy of NSCLC.

the CD44-dependent cisplatin chemoresistance in NSCLC cells can be effectively overcome by the self-targeting downregulation of the CD44 expression.

CD44 is an attractive target for overcoming chemoresistance and that the HA-liposome-based siRNA delivery system is a useful strategy for self-targeting CD44 in chemoresistant cells.
